_notes: Fish Finder Zone 3 — South Atlantic / Southeast (Cape Lookout NC → Cape Canaveral FL). Beta — captain-intel harvesters wired but new; picks rank on seasonal presence + SST fit + reef proximity until captain heat scores accumulate. Bridges Mid-Atl (which reaches to Hatteras) and Zone 5 South Florida (starts at Palm Beach).

home_port.name: Charleston City Marina
home_port.notes: Charleston default — central for the SE coast. World-class inshore + short Gulf Stream run offshore.

boat.notes: Same profile as Zone 1 default — visitor customizes via ⚓ chip.

zones.name: Cape Lookout
zones.notes: Legendary fall false albacore fishery — thousands of light-tackle anglers Oct-Nov. Also the tip of the outer banks arm.

zones.name: Morehead City / Beaufort Inlet
zones.notes: The launching point for the NC offshore fleet. King mackerel tournament capital + Gulf Stream day trips.

zones.name: Bogue Inlet (Emerald Isle)
zones.notes: Emerald Isle's main inlet. Inshore trifecta plus pier + surf.

zones.name: Cape Fear River (Wilmington)
zones.notes: Wilmington's river mouth. Massive redfish flats + docks. Kings run the beaches summer.

zones.name: Frying Pan Shoals / Tower
zones.notes: The offshore tower + shoals 30nm SE of Cape Fear. Mahi + wahoo highway when the Gulf Stream pushes in.

zones.name: The Same Ol' (100/400 Rock)
zones.notes: Classic NC offshore hard-bottom + Gulf Stream ledge 60nm out of Beaufort. Mahi + wahoo trolls + summer tuna.

zones.name: The Big Rock (Marlin Country)
zones.notes: Site of the Big Rock Blue Marlin Tournament (June). One of the most prestigious billfish tournaments on the E coast.

zones.name: Winyah Bay (Georgetown)
zones.notes: Georgetown's massive estuary — four rivers converge. Redfish + trout on the flats + tarpon migration.

zones.name: Charleston Harbor
zones.notes: Charleston Harbor + jetties. Massive redfish fishery on the flats + tarpon rolling under the Ravenel Bridge summer.

zones.name: Charleston Offshore (60-80 Line)
zones.notes: The 60-80 fathom line 50nm off Charleston. Mahi + wahoo + kingfish + occasional sailfish.

zones.name: Edisto Flats
zones.notes: Edisto Island's back-of-the-marsh flats. Sight-fishing redfish on the grass tails.

zones.name: Port Royal Sound (Beaufort SC)
zones.notes: Beaufort SC's deep sound — spring cobia migration is enormous (peak Apr-May). Also great redfish/trout year-round.

zones.name: Hilton Head / Broad River
zones.notes: Hilton Head Island / Broad River / Calibogue Sound. Resort area but excellent inshore + offshore access.

zones.name: Tybee Island / Savannah River
zones.notes: Savannah's beach + river mouth. Tybee pier + Wassaw Sound. Redfish + trout + summer tarpon rolling.

zones.name: St. Simons / Brunswick (Golden Isles)
zones.notes: The Golden Isles inshore stack. St. Simons Sound + Jekyll Creek + Turtle River. Tarpon Jul-Aug.

zones.name: Georgia Live Bottom / KC Reef
zones.notes: GA's offshore live-bottom reefs (KC, R6, etc.) 30-50nm out. Kingfish + AJ + grouper structure fishing.

zones.name: Jacksonville / Mayport Inlet
zones.notes: The St. John's River mouth + Mayport jetties. Fall flounder run + winter kingfish + year-round reds.

zones.name: St. Augustine (Matanzas Inlet)
zones.notes: St. Augustine + Matanzas inlets. Redfish flats + tarpon summer + kingfish just off the beach.

zones.name: Ponce Inlet (Daytona)
zones.notes: Daytona's main inlet. Legendary summer tarpon fishery just offshore + kingfish at the jetty.

zones.name: Port Canaveral
zones.notes: Cape Canaveral's port. The Gulf Stream is close in here — kingfish + sails + mahi within 15-20nm. Southern boundary of Zone 3.

zones.name: The Manning Line
zones.notes: Offshore Cape Lookout. Yellowfin spring, marlin summer.

zones.name: Winyah Bay Grounds
zones.notes: Live bottom 25nm off SC line. Grouper + snapper.

zones.name: Wrightsville 15-Mile Rock
zones.notes: Classic hard bottom 15nm off Wrightsville Beach. Kings all summer.

zones.name: Wrightsville 23-Mile Rock
zones.notes: Deeper live bottom 23nm SE Wrightsville. Bigger kings + AJs.

zones.name: The Ten-Mile Boxcars
zones.notes: Artificial reef of sunken railcars. Kings + Spanish.

zones.name: The Steeples
zones.notes: Offshore hump 50nm SE Wrightsville. Yellowfin school.

zones.name: Swansboro Hole
zones.notes: Deep structure hole. Grouper + AJ year-round.

zones.name: Georgetown Hole
zones.notes: Legendary Gulf Stream break 55nm E Georgetown. All-species spot.

zones.name: Charleston Bump
zones.notes: Massive underwater plateau. Marlin ground August-September.

zones.name: Blackfish Bank
zones.notes: Live bottom 25nm E Georgetown. Sea bass + grouper.

zones.name: Edisto Banks
zones.notes: Nearshore banks off Edisto Island. Popular king run.

zones.name: Hilton Head Snapper Banks
zones.notes: Well-known snapper banks 25nm SE Hilton Head.

zones.name: The Deli Belly
zones.notes: Offshore break north of Charleston Bump. Wahoo winter.

zones.name: Gray's Reef NMS
zones.notes: National Marine Sanctuary 19mi off Sapelo Island. Regulated species.

zones.name: Sapelo Live Bottom
zones.notes: Wide live bottom system. Bottom fishing productive.

zones.name: Long Reef (GA)
zones.notes: Deep ledge system 40nm off Brunswick.

zones.name: R-6 Navy Tower Wreck
zones.notes: Sunken navy tower structure. Big amberjack.

zones.name: Georgia Snapper Banks
zones.notes: Historic snapper banks 60nm off Brunswick. Deep water.

zones.name: Elton Bottom
zones.notes: Rocky bottom 25nm SE Amelia Island. Bottom fish + kings.

zones.name: 20-Fathom Ledge (Jacksonville)
zones.notes: Continental shelf edge 40nm off Jax. Wahoo + tuna trolling.

zones.name: Nine Mile Reef (Amelia)
zones.notes: Nearshore reef complex 9nm off Amelia Island. Kings + cobia.

zones.name: St. Augustine Ledge
zones.notes: Rocky ledge 20nm off St. Augustine. Snapper year-round.

zones.name: Lion Wreck
zones.notes: 300ft cargo ship wreck. Deep structure.
